skeleton._comment: #423: Hedault's own shop, indoors off the boulevard (user ruling 2026-08-10). Schema modelled on stationer.json -- small interior, perimeter is walls.segments so wall cells are NEVER also in `blocked`; `blocked` holds furniture only, each with a matching decor row. Biome + every sprite reused, zero biomes.json edits. No floor_layers: the brothers_parlor biome default is the plain interior board, which is neither the parlor's parquet nor the stationer's pale swatch -- a bespoke enchanter floor is a VISUAL-LOG art follow-up, not a blind region pick. THE POINT OF THE MAP: Hedault stands at (2,3) with THREE orthogonally-adjacent standable cells -- (1,3), (3,3), (2,4) -- every one of them walk-reachable from the shop door's landing at (6,7). The alleys placement he came from had none, which is issue #423.

entities._comment: Round-trip pair with boulevard_enchanter_shop (invrisil_boulevard cell 22,1). Landing (6,7) is the open cell directly north of this door -- standable, off every prop, and the start of every walk in this map's QA legs.

#423: Hedault relocated from mercantile_alleys (0,6), where north and west were blocked, the bench sat east and the door cell sat south -- no standable cell could face him. Here (1,3)/(3,3)/(2,4) are all open and all reachable from (6,7). His talk_pool and `conversation` MOVED with him verbatim (not copied -- the alleys row is deleted in the same edit, so the anti-duplication gate stays satisfied).
The enchanting bench fiction, brought in off the street. Sprite reuses the shipped temper_bench; a bespoke enchanter's bench is a VISUAL-LOG art follow-up.

#423 THE [Pick Lock] DEBUT GATE, and the shape that keeps the two modes honest. `door_when` and `requires_skill` on ONE prop: interactions.gd checks door_when FIRST (line 93), so once `enchanter_work_room_opened` banks -- by the pick OR by Hedault's own arm -- this same interact becomes the transition, with no presence flip and therefore no same-map render ghost (the GH#104 class). Unmet + skill unknown falls through to use_skill's SKILL_UNKNOWN + locked_toast; unmet + skill known answers with skill_hint_toast (the explicit-Skill-use directive: interact never auto-casts).

enchanter_work_room._comment: Descriptive registry (runtime never reads it): the work-room's TWO modes, contents identical. Mode 0 is the [Pick Lock] debut. Mode 1 is the virtuous path -- Hedault opens the door himself once the lady's commission is settled (hedault_enchanting's `work_room` arm), which is why it declares the non-skill `dialogue` gate rather than a skill union.

segments._comment: The work-room partition, west arm: seals x7 at y1..y2 so the back pocket (x8..10, y1..2) has exactly ONE opening.
The partition's south arm. The gap it leaves at (8,3) is the work-room door -- the [Pick Lock] debut gate.
